query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_31_12,
  SUM(finalAmount) as total_amount
FROM sales 
WHERE saleType = 'DELIVERY'
  AND saleDate >= '2024-12-31 00:00:00' 
  AND saleDate <= '2024-12-31 23:59:59'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
